scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web 'npm run dev -w @keel/api' 'npm run dev -w @keel/web'
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @keel/web && esbuild apps/api/src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=apps/api/dist/server.js --sourcemap
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: eslint . --fix && prettier --write apps packages scripts tests examples infrastructure docs .github *.json *.ts *.mjs README.md && tsx scripts/format-sql.ts
scripts.format:check: npm run lint && prettier --check apps packages scripts tests examples infrastructure docs .github *.json *.ts *.mjs README.md && tsx scripts/format-sql.ts --check
